task: I need to set up Brevo to manage our email campaigns. I'll create a contact list and add a few contacts by hand, then build email campaigns for different segments: a welcome email, a feature update and a promotional offer (drafts or scheduled, never sent). Then I'll segment the contacts by engagement or product interest, set up a simple automation for new sign-ups, and review the campaign reports area.

observations.what: After email verification Brevo requires a full organization postal address (address, postal code, city, country, then a State dropdown that only appears after choosing the country), which took about 8 steps.
The plan page shows four paid cards (Starter $9, Standard $18, Professional, Enterprise) and the 'Select Free' button only appears after scrolling well below them.
The cookie consent banner covered the 'Continue' button on the profile step until cookies were rejected.
Creating a list fails silently until a Folder is chosen, even though the only option is the auto-created 'Your First Folder', adding two extra clicks to a basic action.
Once the folder was picked, the 'Demo Alpha Newsletter' list was created from a side panel and appeared immediately in the lists table with its ID and folder.
The Campaigns listing page showed only a spinner for 15+ seconds across three observations and never rendered, so I could not start the welcome, feature-update or promo drafts.
A fresh free account shows a persistent red 'Your account is under review' banner across every page, pointing to a Deliverability center.
In the Marketing menu, Forms carries a lock icon and Landing pages a paid-plan crown on the new free account, so a sign-up form to feed a new-subscriber automation is not immediately available.
The sidebar clearly groups CRM (Contacts, Lists, Segments) and Marketing (Campaigns, Statistics, Templates) plus Automations, so the areas the task needs were easy to locate.
I spent about 24 of 39 steps on sign-up and two steps on a dropdown I mishandled, leaving no budget for contacts, campaigns, segments, automation or reports.
